# UV-00 document fixtures

These files are synthetic and contain no production data, credentials, or real
reviewer identity.

- `order-v1.md` is the approved source used to create an existing suite/run.
- `order-v2.md` keeps the two negative scenarios and changes only the happy-path
  steps/test data by introducing `payment_method=COD`.

They characterize source freshness and historical-chunk defects before UV-01
changes the behavior.
